name: Jenschke Orchards
description: In Fredericksburg, TX, Jenschke Orchards raises Blackberries, Peaches, Plums, Tomatoes, and Pecans on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
